therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis inhibition and anti-proliferative effects
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progress free survival (PFS) for phase II; Maximum Tolerance Dose (MTD) for phase I

safety_signals: High incidence of severe radiation pneumonia
results.dose_information: Anlotinib 12mg QD PO d1-14, 21 days per cycle, combined with radiotherapy (1.8-2.0 Gy daily, 54-66 Gy total) and chemotherapy (platinum + docetaxel for squamous or platinum + pemetrexed for adenocarcinoma)

context.investigator_commentary: High incidence of severe radiation pneumonia
